purpose: Establish the original full rigid-ground mission with home-seeded author iLQG and an explicit fixed-plane residual.

upstream.patch_status: Applied and agent_server rebuilt successfully on 2026-10-27; physical mission outcomes recorded separately.

execution.model_transport: Agent(run_init=False), then init(send_as='xml') with absolute on-host mesh paths.
execution.transport: SSH to the existing host; run the bounded pipeline in tmux per the latest user instruction on 2026-10-27.

resource_policy.GPU: Only recorded-state video rendering; existing workloads retained.

startup.policy_seed: home keyframe ctrl after restoring home data; preserve nullptr behavior without home.
startup.ground_height_enable_condition: Adapter confirms the actual floor is a world-static horizontal plane; write its world height as one scalar.
startup.G1_ground_height_m: Read the actual project floor; do not assume zero.
startup.state_and_goal: Hold the actual initial qpos/qvel/time, complete Stand settings and initial mission goal fixed.
retain: home ctrl and pre-optimization nominal seed action
each of the 20 best trajectories: states, actions, times and iteration number
each initial action and the final feedback action before the first physical step
all initialization errors and subsequent physical failures
startup.horizon_cost: get_total_cost() is a current-state cost, not the optimized horizon return; never label it horizon convergence.
startup.success_meaning: Initialization completion is not standing or mission success.

G0_author_native.physical_model: Retain the author mass, inertia, passive joints, native collisions and contacts.
G0_author_native.actuator_force_limits: Retain author unbounded force; do not claim project torque-limit coverage.

preserve_physics: joint names and physical joint ranges
actuator gear relationship and original torque limits
initial qpos/qvel except the declared yaw condition
original native rigid floor and contact solref/solimp/margin
G1_project_limits.permitted_model_adaptation: Nonphysical task sites/sensors/name maps and explicit joint-target PD only.
G1_project_limits.joint_target_limits: Original per-joint physical position ranges, mapped by name.
G1_project_limits.actuator_mapping: Identical gear, target bounds and original force/torque limits in predictor and plant; no unmatched post-planning clipping.

phase_A.pass: At least one complete original out-turn-return-terminal-stand mission.
phase_A.failure_action: Stop this round before G1 if neither attempt completes.

phase_B_development.pass: At least one complete original mission with a version/configuration that can be frozen.
phase_B_development.failure_action: Stop before formal conditions if no nominal mission completes.

phase_B_formal.initial_condition_rule: Change only initial root yaw; retain body x/y, joint pose, zero velocities and the fixed world route.
phase_B_formal.freeze: One source/configuration/model/solver version for all three conditions.
phase_B_formal.usable_baseline: All three prescribed conditions complete the original mission within original limits; no statistical robustness claim.

budget.counting: Count every physical start and preserve failures, lost-output and superseded attempts. Identical reused nominal is one start. Caps are not quotas; no allowance transfer.

next_joint_stage.entry: After a usable G1 baseline, integrate standard PPO with frozen PANN and this MPC into one stable complete closed loop.
next_joint_stage.current_round_claim: Execution baseline only; no PINN/PANN+RL+MPC innovation or material-memory benefit claim.

required: actual passed configuration and source/upstream-patch/server-binary/model hashes
startup seed and all 20 initialization best trajectories
every physical start, exact command, phase/outcome and unexecuted stages
continuous actual base/feet/joints/targets/torques/contact trajectories and full videos
planner/feedback/physics/wall timings; distinguish simulated from wall-time rates
continuous actual foot ground reaction forces, distinct from contact flags
best predictions during the full actual mission, aligned with recorded states
outputs.publication: Commit compact results and code; upload new large arrays/videos directly from execution host to Release. Reference old evidence.

delivery.end_after: Confirm GitHub commit and required Release asset size/digest; no user-PC copy/download/archive.

forbidden: defensive programming and generic fallback frameworks
gain/cost/integrator search or relaxed mission/physical limits
neural/RL training, materials or hardware in this round
claiming G0 success as G1 success
